[[File:Dean Irwin 2020.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Dean Irwin in 2020]]
'''Dean Irwin''' was Decipher's director of sales and is credited on the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] team (2001).<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="icv2b">[https://icv2.com/articles/games/view/1351/decipher-star-wars-wind-up Decipher Star Wars Wind-up], ICv2 (29 April 2002). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013173913/https://icv2.com/articles/games/view/1351/decipher-star-wars-wind-up Internet Archive]</ref> He later founded Enterplay, which published the ''My Little Pony'' Collectible Card Game from 2013.<ref name="icv2-irwin">Jim McLauchlin, [https://icv2.com/articles/columns/view/45201/business-3x3-dean-irwin-recently-enterplay Business 3x3: Dean Irwin, Recently of Enterplay], ICv2 (19 February 2020). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261015183402/https://icv2.com/articles/columns/view/45201/business-3x3-dean-irwin-recently-enterplay Internet Archive]</ref>
